output.reasoning: The listing clearly disclosed minor scuffs on the sleeves and pointed to photos, so the sleeve wear is not a surprise. The buyer also reports a worn collar, which the listing did not mention and which was not photographed, so part of the complaint is fair. Offering a partial refund of 50 CAD resolves the undisclosed collar wear without refunding the full price for an item described as pre-owned with visible scuffs.

evidenceUsed.point: The listing description said pre-owned, good condition, with minor scuffs on sleeves and see photos.
The seller says the listing photos show the sleeve scuffs and the collar was not photographed.
The buyer reports scuffs on both sleeves and a worn collar, and says the jacket is not as described.
Canada Post tracking shows the order was delivered on 2026-10-20 with no signature on delivery.
The disputed amount is 240 CAD and the case is at the inquiry stage with 12 days left.

evidenceGaps: Photos of the collar or any other condition details that were not shown in the listing.
Whether the buyer has asked for a return or has returned the jacket.
Any pre-sale messages with the buyer about the jacket's condition.
Clear photos of the sleeves as listed, to confirm the scuffs match what was disclosed.

alternatives.whyNot: The collar wear was not disclosed or photographed, so the seller would have weak evidence against that part of the claim.
The sleeve scuffs were disclosed in the listing, so a full refund would overpay for a claim that is only partly valid.

output.draftNote: Thank you for your message about order DEMO-wear-vs-listing. The listing described this pre-owned leather jacket as good condition with minor scuffs on the sleeves, and the photos showed those sleeve scuffs. I acknowledge that the collar wear was not shown in the listing, so I would like to offer a partial refund of 50 CAD to resolve this. Please let me know if you accept this offer.
nextSteps: Send the partial refund offer of 50 CAD through the dispute.
Gather the listing screenshot and sleeve photos to keep on file in case the offer is declined.
Respond promptly if the buyer asks questions or requests a return.
